channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: City of Westlake expands homebuying program after surge in applications, raises purchase limit to $679,324
item.description: A WPTV story about the City of Westlake's homebuying program sparked more than 200 inquiries, leading city leaders to expand eligibility and increase the home purchase limit.

item.title: Westlake expands homebuying assistance program after WPTV report sparks surge in applications
item.description: A WPTV news report about a City of Westlake homebuying assistance program generated a wave of applications that prompted city leaders to expand the initiative. item.title: Westlake expands homebuying assistance program after surge in applications
item.description: The City of Westlake received more than 200 inquiries and awarded assistance to 22 families after WPTV coverage of its HAPPY program in April.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description: A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes today for $3 million renovation to nearly double boat slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closed July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce transforms Crain Estate into artistic destination
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination by preserving the legacy of the historic Crain Estate and connecting local and international artists.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiancée in deadly home fire
item.description: A Hobe Sound man is leaning on his community after losing his fiancée, Misty Dawn White, in a deadly home fire earlier this week.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit rescues two after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from marine deputies and the life-saving decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with Venus due to knee injury
item.description: The 44-year-old tennis star withdrew from her scheduled doubles match after fluid was drained from her knee following her singles return match earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina beats Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time to advance to World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina survived a challenge from Cape Verde in South Florida, advancing to face Egypt in Atlanta on Tuesday.

item.title: FIFA lifts Folarin Balogun suspension after Trump calls president before U.S. World Cup match
item.description: President Donald Trump intervened on behalf of the American striker, whose red-card suspension was lifted in time for Monday's World Cup match against Belgium in Seattle.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots are putting in summer work as they prepare for the 2026 fall football season with their sights set on a state title. item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets ended their nine-game losing streak Sunday afternoon with a late offensive surge, rallying past the Tampa Tarpons for a 10-5 win at Clover Park.
